name: 02b_double_split_1tick_gap
description: Same as 02a, but the second split is processed one server tick (40 ms) after the first, like the client's fallback double-split macro. The first piece has already flown ~87 units, so the pieces spread differently.

name: 03_backpiece_eat

When the 13-tick no-collide window ends, A's stacked pieces spring apart, and B's 9,250 launched half (>1.3x bigger) eats the quarter pieces it reaches.

name: 04_autosplit
description: Autosplit check. A is a single 20k cell; B (10k) splits at A, A eats the 5k piece and reaches 25k, which is over the 22,500 single-cell limit, so A autosplits into two 12.5k cells (random angle).
